name: Woodside Energy Group Ltd
research_rationale: Scarborough near start-up, Louisiana offtake and a 20–40% cash-flow dividend framework ease payout risk, but indexed FY25 FCF is negative, quarterly cash flow is unverified and oil-surplus headlines still weaken the buy case.

weekly_updates.summary:
Press since late October centres on Scarborough nearing first LNG, Q3 2026 production up 12%, and Louisiana LNG progress including a QatarEnergy offtake and Trafigura supply coverage.  
Capital-markets reporting cites a dividend reset to 20–40% of cash flow and 500+ role cuts; Browse CCS moved to full EIS while WA secured a federal gas-reservation exemption subject to parliamentary approval.  
Indexed FY25 Yahoo metrics still show negative free cash flow and empty quarterly cash flow; the buy screen persists but the adjusted signal remains hold.
